  <div class="page-width page-width--narrow"><div class="theme-block" ><h2>Our Kite Camps</h2></div><div class="theme-block" ><div class="rte"><p><strong>Elevation’s Women’s Kite Camps are the way to go for any women that would like to give kiteboarding a try, meet other women kiteboarder’s or just push their skills to the next level.</strong></p><p>Our experienced instructors, women specific gear and the fun shared experience has proved to be a winning combination. This camp is built to help women become safe, independent and confident kiteboarders.</p><p>Our 3 day kite camp for women taught is a fun and non-intimidating way to learn.</p><p>Womenʼs camps are 3 days long, the perfect amount of time to go through all the safeties, practice launching and landing, kite flying, kite control, self rescue, body dragging, introducing the board, riding or improving your kiteboarding skills if you are no longer a beginner. From years of hosting women’s camps, we have found that the group setting creates a non-intimidating and confidence building atmosphere, promoting a positive experience to the camp participants.</p><p>Our aim for all our students is to teach you the skills to become an independent, safe and confident kiteboarder.</p><p>The camps runs from 10:30 am to about 4 or 5 pm. We ask students to bring a lunch and some water, your wetsuit. In Nitinat, the lake is ocean-fed and is cooler. We recommend bringing a 5,4 mil full wetsuit and booties to keep you warm. In La Ventana the water is warmer !! Please bring a 4/3 mil wetsuit and booties as well. The lessons are watercraft assisted with the instructor beside the student on the water. We provide all the kiteboarding equipment and use the latest Duotone kites and boards.</p><p>———</p><p><strong>Day 1</strong> will consist of all kite flying and safety stuff for beginners. Intermediate students will get a good safety refresher then get to the water.</p><p><strong>Day 2 </strong>Water all day 🙂</p><p><strong>Day 3</strong> Water all day</p><p>We supply all of the equipment but suggest that you bring your own wetsuit and booties.</p><p>If you would like to learn on your own gear, bring it with you, we are happy to help you get to know it. </p><p></p><p></p><h3><strong>Need accommodation?</strong></h3><p><strong>La Ventana:</strong> <a href="https://bajajoe.com/" title="https://bajajoe.com/">Baja Joe’s in La Ventana</a></p><p><strong>Nitinat Lake:</strong> <a href="/pages/contact" title="Contact"><span style="text-decoration:underline">Contact Us</span></a></p><p></p><p></p>
</div></div><div class="theme-block" ><div class="rte">
